newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pertamina allocates 300,000 bbls more July LSWR.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina allocates 300,000 bbls more July LSWR.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina has allocated a further of 300,000 barrels of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) in July, industry sources said on Tuesday.
They said most of the additional supplies were allocated to Indonesia's affiliate Permindo.
Pertamina first allocated 2.3 million barrels of LSWR in July. The additional allocation would bring Pertamina's total allocation for July to 2.6 million barrels.
This is significantly lower than Pertamina's June allocation at 3.1 million barrels.
The reduced supplies from Indonesia was due to a shutdown of a 100,000 barrels-per-day crude unit at Cilicap refinery.
The tight allocation, strong demand in Japan because of a heatwave have coupled to push LSWR prices in Singapore higher.
Prices in Singapore were assessed at $16.10 on Monday, up from $15.85 last week and a low of $15.10 in mid May.
"Total demand is expected to amount to 3.4-3.5 million barrels while supply is just about 2.6 million barrels," said a trader from Jakarta.
